title: Apple says the touchscreen MacBook Pro has a "newly designed hinge" for stability and an "enhanced six-speaker" system; the 14" model is 3lb and the 16" is 4lb (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Apple says the touchscreen MacBook Pro has a “newly designed hinge” for stability and an “enhanced six-speaker” system; the 14" model is 3lb and the 16" is 4lb — Apple has long resisted the idea of touchscreen laptops — until now.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Apple says the touchscreen MacBook Pro has a “newly designed hinge” for stability and an “enhanced six-speaker” system; the 14" model is 3lb and the 16" is 4lb   —  Apple has long resisted the idea of touchscreen laptops — until now.
